r02.

**Premise correction:** There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in this codebase. A repo-wide search for rate-limiting/throttling logic (`ratelimit`, `rate.limit`, `throttle`) turns up only a single doc comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86` — a suggestion in the email package's documentation ("Rate limit email sending to prevent abuse") that is not backed by any implementation. Likewise, inspecting the Echo middleware actually registered in the server shows only `middleware.Recover()` (panic recovery, `server/server.go:51`), `middleware.CORSWithConfig` (CORS, `server/cors.go:14`), and `middleware.StaticWithConfig` (static file serving, `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54`) — no rate limiter (Echo's own `middleware.RateLimiter` or any hand-rolled equivalent) is wired in anywhere, and there's no `golang.org/x/time/rate` or similar dependency in `go.mod`/`go.sum`.

**Actual mechanism:** None exists. If per-user rate limiting is desired, it would need to be added — there's no existing site to point to.
